lessons.trigger_condition: V420 could compute evidence activation scores and promotion gates, but the durable registry intentionally retained seed activation values and the tablet WATCH summary showed mostly catalog depth. Operators could not reliably see why a candidate was held or promotion-eligible after a review cycle, reducing diagnosability of autonomous decisions.
lessons.prevention_rule: Keep tcg_game_registry.json seed activation values immutable as declarative configuration. After each successful review, publish a bounded tcg_registry_review.json explanation snapshot containing effective/seed/evidence scores, gate booleans and allowlisted hold reasons only. Snapshot failure preserves the last-known-good file and never blocks mandatory collectors. Tablet UI treats the snapshot as optional, validates it fail-closed, and falls back to registry-only display if absent or invalid.
validation_required: reviewed rows expose allowlisted promotion hold reasons
review snapshot is schema-bounded to 64 rows and does not contain profit or price-direction prediction
review snapshot does not mutate declarative registry activation_score
successful auto update writes the review snapshot after registry review
snapshot failure preserves last-known-good explanation and does not fail mandatory collectors
tablet UI validates optional review snapshot and falls back when unavailable
WATCH UI can display evidence score and up to two localized hold reasons
Pokémon ONE PIECE NARUTO remain the only grading-enabled game IDs
screen neural stays exactly 17 inputs 12 hidden units and 18 outputs
profit guarantee investment-return prediction and market-direction prediction remain false
no arbitrary source rewrite direct-main write command generation or verification bypass is introduced
physical Lenovo deployment remains unverified until device-side receipt exists
lessons.safety_boundary: The snapshot is explanatory telemetry only. It cannot promote a game, enable grading, change source code, predict profit/price direction, fabricate inventory, or weaken existing registry evidence gates.
